question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
Recount
solution:
The correct answer is: **Suppress**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Recount"** means to narrate or tell someone about an event or experience in detail. (विवरण देना)

 
 
• **Example:** She recounted her childhood memories during the family gathering.
 
 
 
• **"Suppress"** means to stop something by force, restrain, or prevent the expression of feelings, emotions, or actions. (दबाना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The government tried to suppress the protests by imposing restrictions.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Recount' **is **'Suppress'**, as it refers to an action that prevents the narration or expression of something.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Suppress**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Narrate** (कथन करना): To tell a story or describe a series of events. 
 
 
• **Example:** The author narrated the story of his adventurous journey in the mountains.
 
 
 
 
• **Retell** (दोबारा बताना): To tell a story or event again, often in a different way.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher asked the students to retell the story in their own words.
 
 
 
 
• **Detail** (विस्तार से बताना): To describe something fully or give all the particulars.
 
 
• **Example:** The witness provided a detailed account of the incident to the police.

सही उत्तर है: **Suppress**.
